description.narrative:
Den svenska ambassaden i Moçambique har mottagit ett förslag från UN Resident Coordinators Office (RCO) för att finansiera en Nexus-koordinatorpost och en FN-volontärpost (UNV) med placering i Pemba, huvudstad i provinsen Cabo Delgado under två år med möjlighet till förlängning.
Insatsens målsättning är att förbättra utvecklingseffektiviteten genom samordning mellan humanitära och långsiktiga utvecklingsåtgärder, såväl som mellan FN-organ, andra utvecklingsaktörer och med staten på olika nivåer.

The Swedish Embassy in Mozambique has received a proposal from the UN Resident CoordinatorsOffice (RCO) to fund a Nexus Coordinator post and a United Nations Volunteer post to be placed in Pemba, the Cabo Delgado provincial capital, under the realm of the RCO. It is be a two-year post with possibility for extension.
The intervention's main objective is to improve development effectiveness through coordination between humanitarian and long term development actions, as well as between UN agencies and with government.

The initial purpose of this contribution was to support the RCO Pemba office with a number of staff positions, including a P5 nexus position during a two year period with the purpose of enhancing coordination between recovery, peace and development in Cabo Delgado. Due to shortcomings in the recruitment process, it was decided to reduce and reshape the support to a one year agreement with support to a national level Maputo-based coordination position. This coordination function will mainly support the DCP secretariat (Development Cooperation Platform), and the two DCP chairs (Sweden and the RCO), but also offer support to the RCO office and RC/HC in general.

The purpose of this contribution was to support the RC-Office with a Senior Regional Coordinator for the North of Mozambique to ensure a well coordinated response in the areas of recovery, resilience, development and peace building. Due to a change in set up within the UN offices and short-comings from the RC-Office, the recruitment of such a position failed. Instead the financial contribution from Sweden was heavily reduced, and used to support the RC-Office with a Coordination Officer. The Coordination Officer was responsible for providing support to an enhanced Development Cooperation Platform (DCP) Secretariat and to the Resident Coordinator (RC) as Co-Chair of the DCP. No long term sustainable catalytic change can be ascribed a result of this contribution, as it rather was used for supporting the running of the RCO and the donor coordination structure. However, the role financed was of importance to support the functioning of these roles and functions.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
